description: Dispatch needs tomorrow's berth list from the Harbour Office before the convoys are planned. The Harbour Office will not send it, on principle.
name: Berth List

objectives.desc: Collect tomorrow's berth list at the Harbour Office.
emotes: {who} waits while a harbour clerk copies out a berth list by hand, slowly, on principle.

objectives.desc: Bring it back to Halcyon Logistics dispatch.
emotes: {who} puts a hand-copied berth list on the dispatcher's desk. He reads it without putting the handset down.
